sentences.text: Raj Kumar Dhanuka vs Unknown on 1 August, 2018

Author: Sanjib Banerjee
Bench: Sanjib Banerjee

1
55 01.8.2018
C.R.M. 5511 of 2018 In the matter of: Raj Kumar Dhanuka ....petitioner.
gd Mr. Sandipan Ganguly Mr. Atis Kumar Biswas Mr. Amit Singh ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Sourav Chatterjee Ms. Sayanti Santra ...for the State.

The petitioner claims that the petitioner has been booked under the Prevention of Food
Adulteration Act, when such Act is no longer in operation.
Let the matter appear a fortnight hence.
The Investigating Officer is directed to submit a report.
Till the matter is next taken up by this court, the petitioner will not be arrested in connection with this criminal case, though he may be summoned for interrogation.

(Sanjib Banerjee, J.) (Abhijit Gangopadhyay, J.)
